lines.en: I walk through the mire's mud.
The mud water reaches my waist.
This bog is mine.

lines.zh: 里面别的东西都清掉了。
lines.en: I have cleared out everything else in it.
I press through the reeds, step by step.
They snap beneath me.
Only I still stand here.
The mud churns around my feet.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下水痕。
lines.en: Wet tracks follow wherever I walk.
Weeds hang on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 泥水从我的背上流下去。
lines.en: Mud water runs down my back.
I flatten a path through the reeds.
I crouch in the shallows.
The whole mire is quiet.
I made it so, little by little.
The waterweed on my head keeps dripping.
An insect circles on the water.
I could not be bothered with it.
That does not count for anything.
I know this smell well.
Mud, rotting grass, and water.
I sit in the mud.
You walked in yourself.
This mire does not welcome guests.
Have you looked around.
There is nothing left here.
Now only you and I remain.
I am behind you.
You are very clean.
That will not last.
Your hand is reaching for a rope.
There is nothing here to climb.
I sink a little.
Mud smears the wound.

lines.zh: 这点伤在这地方不算什么。
lines.en: Such a wound means little here.
There is a little red in the water.
I crouch lower.
A crack opens in my shell.
I glance down at it.
Nothing to see.
I sink a little into the water.
The wound soaks in the mud.
What you brought.
I have no need of this.
This mire feeds me well.
Put it away.
It offends me.
This mire is mine. Do not wander.
This mire will not make way for you.
That small smell on your hands.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西不够腥。
lines.en: What you hold is not fishy enough.
That is nowhere near enough.
You ran into me headlong.
Only I am left in this mire.
You gave half a step.
The mud has your boots.

lines.zh: 我的湿皮肤蹭过你的腿。
lines.en: My wet skin brushes your leg.
The mud pushes at your legs.
You are unsteady in the mud.
You hold the reeds to stand.
Those reeds will snap first.
I step half a pace around you.
Only I am left here.
Guess for yourself.
Stop asking.
This water holds room for one.
That is a strange thing to ask.

lines.zh: 我连一个同类都没见过。
lines.en: I have never even met one of my own kind.
Only I keep this mire now.

lines.zh: 水里不会生出第二个我。
lines.en: The water will not make a second me.
You are thinking too much.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽只养得起一个。
lines.en: This mire can only feed one.
There is something under the mud.
My fingers have found it.
It is a bone.
It is not one of mine.
I fling it aside.
I press it back into the mud.
That is simpler this way.
I feel another one.
This bone is bigger.
It sank again.
You stepped into my water.

lines.zh: 这里的每一寸都是我的。
lines.en: Every inch of this is mine.

lines.zh: 你踩到的东西都知道我。
lines.en: Everything you step on knows me.
You will not leave this mud.
The mud will keep you.

lines.zh: 水面的涟漪朝你推过去。
lines.en: Ripples on the water push toward you.
Your feet are already sinking.
You are still thrashing.
This is quite good.
This can drag on a long while.
I am behind you already.
Turning around will not help.
The sound comes from the water.
Your boots are full of water.
Every step must be heavy.

lines.zh: 苦海沼泽只剩我一个主人。
lines.en: I'm the only master left in this mire.
I stand on your way back.

lines.zh: 你往左，那边是更深的泥。
lines.en: You go left; the mud is deeper there.
You go right; the weeds tangle.

lines.zh: 这里的每根芦苇我都认识。
lines.en: I know every reed in this marsh.

lines.zh: 你跑起来的每一步我都算过。
lines.en: I have counted every step you could run.
Your strength is sinking.
The mud holds your boots.
The harder you pull, the deeper you go.
I need not take a single step.
I only have to wait.

lines.zh: 我蹲低，水没到我的下巴。
lines.en: I crouch until the water reaches my chin.
I step into the shallows, one step at a time.
That is you floundering.
I will not move at all.
The mud here is patient.
I am more patient still.
My fingers are under the water.
You have not seen them.
My hands are under the water.
I am feeling my way toward you.
I reach out of the mud and grab you.
Mud splashes all over you.
You are dragged lower.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣进你的衣领。
lines.en: My claws dig into your collar.
Below is soft mud.
Your legs will not come free.
My palm is bigger than your face.
You are still shouting.
Nobody hears, here.

lines.zh: 我的蹼掌按住你的小腿。
lines.en: My webbed hand clamps your calf.
The mud swallows you at once.
You are dragged knee deep.
Then I loosen a little.
Only to frighten you.
Your hands claw at the surface.
The surface cannot be gripped.
I press down again.
This time it reaches your waist.
Your head is still above it.
Not for much longer.
The water begins to bubble.
I lift my head from beneath the swamp.
My back shows first.
Then my hands.

lines.zh: 这里的生物都躲起来了。
lines.en: Everything living here has hidden.
They knew I was coming.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽从今天起安静了。
lines.en: This mire will be quiet from today.
The reeds fall in waves.

lines.zh: 我走过的路上什么都不剩。
lines.en: Nothing remains along my path.
Mud slides off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这座沼泽的边我一圈走过。
lines.en: I have walked the rim of this mire once.
The water only reaches my knees.
Fire will not catch on this water.
I fall into the deep mud.
I live in this water already.
The blast throws up a sheet of mud.
Something sharp sticks in my back.

lines.zh: 那法术让我的腿一时动不了。
lines.en: That spell pins my legs a moment.
This mire will not starve me thin.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面上，一路烧到我这。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and runs to me.
The mud and water are gone together.
